snippet.title: Kickback — Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Kickback release date has been announced! The game will be available on Steam from July 14, 2025!

Wishlist on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753870/Kickback_Shoot_to_Move/

Repel waves of mutants, create combinations of weapons and upgrades to optimally navigate the enclosed arena and avoid collisions with enemies.

#kickback #indiegame
